project_title: Silversy 3D Hero Hand & Fine Jewellery Photorealism Blueprint
context: Enhancement of existing Three.js / React Three Fiber interactive 3D hero hand with fine silver and diamond jewellery in /app/frontend/src/three/
target_aesthetic: Premium Light Editorial SILVERSY Styling with Photorealistic 3D Silver, High-Refractive Faceted Diamonds, Natural Hand Joint/Knuckle Micro-anatomy, and Subtle Glossy Fingernails
core_issues_identified: Washed-out skin shader lacking anatomical finger knuckles, creases, and natural skin tone subsurface depth
Missing fingernails on fingers and thumb
Milky / transparent diamond material lacking high-refractive internal sparkle, proper depth, and sharp specular facets
Flat, pale white silver material lacking deep metallic reflections, contrast, and mirror polish
Studio environment lighting lacking high-contrast specular highlights required for realistic metal chrome and gem brilliance

glsl_procedural_enhancements.knuckle_anatomical_lines: In GLSL shader replacement, generate localized transverse finger joint flexure lines (knuckle creases) along each finger phalanx (Z axis of finger object coordinates: proximal at ~0.04 to 0.06, intermediate at ~0.09 to 0.11, distal flexure at ~0.14). Use smoothstep band masks combined with high-frequency micro-crease noise to create realistic knuckle folds and skin tension lines.
glsl_procedural_enhancements.fingernail_rendering: Detect finger tip coordinates (z > 0.15 on distal phalanx / obj pos y/z limits). Create glossy fingernail beds with defined nail lunula and cuticle curves using GLSL distance fields: apply higher clearcoat (0.95), lower roughness (0.12), and slight translucent pinkish tone (#f3d7d4) for nail bed vs surrounding skin color (#f0e6dd).
glsl_procedural_enhancements.skin_micro_texture: Adjust normal perturbation magnitude and multi-frequency FBM (fine pores + skin direction lines) so knuckles show visible micro-wrinkles while palm/dorsal skin remains soft and natural.

silver_material_upgrades.visual_impact: Produces crisp, deep dark-and-light environment reflections characteristic of mirror-polished sterling silver 925.

gem_geometry_enhancements.emerald_cut: Refine EMERALD geometry facets with sharp bevels, step-cut pavilion facets, and prominent table geometry for realistic light refraction on the index finger ring.
gem_geometry_enhancements.brilliant_cut: Ensure BRILLIANT gem geometry has proper crown, girdle, pavilion angles and 32 faceted triangles so light refracts with fire.
gem_geometry_enhancements.facet_glints: Maintain and enhance FacetGlint sprites on ring gemstones and tennis bracelet stones for dynamic scroll sparkles.

HandJewellery_jsx.jewellery_proportions: Preserve exact physical sizes: Index ring emerald solitaire (~15mm x 21mm unit scale), Ring finger solitaire (~9mm unit scale), Wrist tennis bracelet (44 linked bezel settings with individual diamonds).

general_ui_guidelines.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='hero-3d-hand-container', data-testid='product-card-ring').
general_ui_guidelines.responsive_rules: Ensure Canvas rendering maintains smooth 60fps performance across desktop and mobile while staying touch-interactive and scroll-linked.
general_ui_guidelines.accessibility: Provide aria-hidden='true' on purely decorative 3D canvas and maintain fallback image loading state for complete accessibility compliance.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Open /app/frontend/src/three/handRig.js and update makeSkinMaterial GLSL shader code to add transverse knuckle flexure creases and glossy fingernail masks.
2. Open /app/frontend/src/three/HandJewellery.jsx and enhance SILVER (high metallic contrast, roughness 0.06) and DIAMOND (high transmission 0.92, dispersion 0.08, specular 2.0) materials.
3. Open /app/frontend/src/three/HeroHand.jsx and upgrade Environment lightformers and directional lights to create sharp metallic silver reflections and sparkling gem facets.
4. Test that the scroll-scrubbed hand curl animation remains perfectly synchronized and all jewellery remains attached seamlessly.
5. Ensure no code breaking changes are introduced to the rest of the application.
